title: earth-tides 1.0.0: software, scripts and results for "What the IERS body-tide model assumes: Love numbers of a flattened, rotating, anelastic Earth"
description: The Python package earth-tides computes the Love numbers of a flattened, rotating, anelastic Earth with a spectral Galerkin-collocation method, and the body-tide displacement of a station (program etide). This archive contains the package, the scripts that produce every table, figure and number of the paper, the stored results and the figures. paper_scripts/run_all.py reruns the scripts and compares their output with the stored results; README.md lists which script produces which result.
